phase: Trusted QA Phase 2: Held-out Validation + Conservative Enforcement Evidence

pre_generation.candidate_v0_2_reason: Neither the Phase 1 calibration set nor the frozen held-out run produced evidence for an additional safe pre-generation rule. Designing from observed holdout failures would contaminate the holdout.

recommended_future_enforcement_rules: Substantive factual answer with zero valid citations -> fail closed
Any claimed citation failing composite membership validation -> fail closed
Explicit N/A with empty citations -> accept as a valid abstention
post_generation.note: The observed 2/2 candidate fail-closed precision is an invariant-level observation on a small sample, not a stable production estimate.

version_ambiguity.conclusion: A year spanning a version switch must not be rejected. Hard rejection would require a typed resolver outcome showing that the user explicitly requires one unique version and no defensible answer can be formed; current evidence does not contain such a case.

finalization.scope: Document and present the frozen Shadow findings; if enforcement is implemented later, limit it to the separately reviewed post-answer deterministic rules and keep pre-generation cosine decisions in Shadow.
